video:video.video:title: OptimasX: An Agentic End-to-End GPU Performance Optimization Workflow in the Code Editor
video:video.video:description: A one-minute demo of OptimasX, an agentic, end-to-end GPU performance optimization workflow that runs inside the code editor. OptimasX turns GPU code optimization, which usually takes deep expertise and as many as 30 manual steps, into one request to an AI assistant: "Can you make my code run faster?" Research poster at SC'26, nominated for the Best Research Poster Award.
